column1: # The lineage page (/lineage/): the works this repository's line of work descends from or runs beside,
# one row per dated event. Add a row to track a new one; the page sorts by date.
# date: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, as precise as the source states it, never more.
# status: done (it happened, the source says so) or planned (a date someone committed to; the page
#   marks it planned until a row with done replaces it).
# kind: model (a wave, ocean or weather model; the sea light) or port (a model moved to other
#   hardware or another language; the machine light). Nothing else (DESIGN.md, "The lineage").
# line: the family it belongs to, in a word or two. what: one line, lower case. source: where the
#   date and the claim were read, and when.
